reason: The only available combination should let me harvest leaves to take from the garden.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce leaves, which may then be usable in the flight galley.

effect: The harvest produced departure lettuce leaves, ready to use in the flight galley.
reaction: The result is straightforward and expected.
reason: Using the leaves in the flight galley is the only offered combination and should fulfill the goal of taking some garden produce along.
expectation: I expect the leaves to become part of the flight meal, though I don't know exactly how.

effect: The leaves became a flight meal, and the departure sequence carried the lander off the surface, completing the chapter.
reaction: The handful of green felt like a satisfying connection to the garden left behind, though the lift-off was brief.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the leaves into the meal was the most worthwhile moment: it gave the departure a personal link to the garden.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the leaves was straightforward and had no accompanying discovery; it was the least interesting action.

surprise.text: The meal result also moved directly into lift-off, which I had not expected from the galley action.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: harvesting leaves and putting them in the meal both fit the stated goal. Both were the only available combinations.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue, mainly to see what happens to the discovery on Earth, though this short chapter offered little decision-making.
